verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents its own 3D renderer built on WebGL2 and WebGPU with automatic fallback, has materials you can edit live, and offers first-class Gaussian Splat rendering. None of the specific production-renderer features the story names are actually evidenced. missing for 10: documented PBR material model, global illumination or baked lightmapping, shadow support, post-processing effects, independent or hands-on corroboration of render quality.
